findings.text: Open the lid: the camera does not judge the seat under the lifted lid, so Close the seat runs after it and looks first, as on the robot; here it finds the seat down and ends there.

RIGHT row 9, program 56: the controller first moves the arm 1 deg to the program's first point, at its Start % (30 %): that move takes 0.4-0.5 s on the robot, which widens this arm's timing from here.
The lid and seat tasks are ALIX's plans, made with the UGV at 250 mm from the commode and no offset: place the UGV there for them (Lite cannot see the placement).

Open the lid (48.9-99.2 s) is ALIX's plan: its hands hold the lid and the seat by design, so it is left out of this collision check (ALIX's planner checked it with the commode's contact allowances); its camera checks are assumed here, and asked of the camera in Real. Each arm's move to its next task's start after it (99.2-104.7 s) is Lite's own, checked here.

Open the seat (133.4-188.7 s) is ALIX's plan: its hands hold the lid and the seat by design, so it is left out of this collision check (ALIX's planner checked it with the commode's contact allowances); its camera checks are assumed here, and asked of the camera in Real. Each arm's move to its next task's start after it (188.7-195.1 s) is Lite's own, checked here.

The two arms come closer than 50 mm: LEFT row 11 (Program 84 // L_merge_5_1, line 10,679) and RIGHT row 15 (Program 82 // R_merge_7, line 894), about 274 s in: touching (IRH_palm_rubber_1, L_ConnectorLink) when the RIGHT arm runs 7.5 s ahead of the LEFT (in 7 of the 22 timings checked, from +3.1 to +8.5 s). Those timings are within the robot's ranges: keep the arms apart with a Meet or a Wait-for between those rows.

The two arms come closer than 50 mm: LEFT row 5 (Program 80 // L_merge_1, line 1,267) and RIGHT row 5 (Program 80 // R_merge_1_2, line 1,102), about 24 s in: touching (IRH_right_index_2, L_Link6) at every timing checked: those rows put the arms that close whatever their timing. A Meet or a Wait-for in it makes the check finer.
